static.description: Server-rendered route with no external client runtime.

basic-island.description: Server-first route with navigation, forms, or small islands.

wasm-island.description: Route that intentionally loads the GoSX WASM island runtime.

scene3d.description: Interactive Scene3D route profiled on a throttled mobile-class browser.

docs-scene3d-ci.description: Docs route under CI software rasterization with lazy WebGL fallback preserved. Latest measured docs run: network 1516.24KiB (0.24KiB over the prior 1516KiB cap, so the cap moves to 1517KiB), JS 1296.08KiB, LCP 1592ms, TBT 1038ms; the other gates passed.

water-ci.description: Water route under CI software rasterization. Gates load, the reviewed O-series browser-host and runtime payload, and total blocking time; long-task count is intentionally ungated because continuous software-raster frames straddle the 50ms boundary. Real-GPU cadence is certified separately. Remote CI at head 77323ed6 measured 1658.14KiB network payload (LCP 692ms, TBT 5355ms, both passing); the alpha-mask color-pass payload growth adds ~23 raw bytes to the WebGPU chunk and bootstrap relative to that head, so the assertion allows 1659KiB with narrow rounding headroom over the observed remote CI measurement.
